r7zq48bk.baseName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
r7zq48bk.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
r7zq48bk.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 8ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine Half Tree. Its half-tree design combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 300 multi-function warm white LED lights and a generous front profile. Measuring 130cm wide and 75cm deep, it sits neatly against a wall or in a corner, leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Broad lower branches and a classic, tapered shape create a full front display in rooms where floor space is limited. Short-cut pine needle outer branches and inner PVC tips add depth and fullness. Natural green shades and subtle brown detailing create a lovely backdrop for decorations. The fitted warm white LEDs highlight the foliage, with multiple lighting effects to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections, with flexible branches for easy shaping and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

q2nykk0d.baseName: Walplus 200 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
q2nykk0d.variantName: Walplus 200 LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
q2nykk0d.sourceDescription: The fully-decorated Christmas tree with stylish illuminated branches and colourful baubles creates a nice atmosphere in the coming Christmas. The artificial tree is made of PVC, which is lightweight and weather-resistant. The Christmas tree has an IP rating of IP44 and is, therefore, suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The branches can be arranged in any shape you like. They also contain 200 LEDs, which are very energy-efficient and emit a bright warm light. Designed with 4 different lighting effects; continuous lighting, twinkling, crossfade and slowly glowing mode, the lights beautifully illuminate in your preferred pattern. It is a real eye-catcher, especially in the evening. It can also serve as an ambient light source. This Christmas tree can be used every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green Bauble colour: Gold and red Material: PVC, plastic Tree height: 210 cm Maximum tree diameter: 110 cm Voltage: 5 V⎓ Power: 3 W USB interface With 200 LEDs With 910 branches With 4 lighting effects Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree with 200 LEDs 1 x 20 cm gold tree topper 40 x 4 cm bauble (20 x gold and 20 x red) 40 x 6 cm bauble (20 x gold and 20 x red) 30 x Pine cone This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

05ygnvzx.sourceDescription: This Modern Metal Christmas tree exemplifies contemporary elegance, combining the simplicity of minimalist design with the charm of holiday cheer. Styled in a gleaming gold hue and a matte finish, it presents a tasteful blend of style and simplicity suited for any modern home setting. Its sleek form and contour make it an ideal centerpiece for living rooms or hallways, blending seamlessly into any seasonal decor scheme. Tailored for the modern holiday enthusiast, it projects a festive yet understated aura that is both captivating and inviting. Materials: Made from powder-coated steel, this Metal Christmas tree stands out with its robust, abrasion-resistant qualities. The selection of material not only contributes to a sleek modern look but ensures durability and lasting use through several festive seasons. Included Components: The tree features an integrated sturdy steel stand, providing reliable stability to keep it firmly upright. This component minimizes the need for additional supports, making setup straightforward and quick. Features /Function /Design: The tree embodies modern design, offering clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Its gold matte finish enhances its visual appeal, giving a chic touch to traditional Christmas decor while maintaining a functional and practical setup. Recommended Uses: This tree is perfect for both living room and hallway spaces. rr345tkp.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
